description: Marked the cut plot and would not take a fourth leaf.
name: Abel Garnish

description: Pegged the cut book, shut the tally, and held him to the morning's promise.
name: John Heminges

description: Refused a speech out of the chest, and kept the counsel to the book.
name: Richard Burbage

description: Played Gaunt in the cut book.
name: William Shakespeare
